acceptance_criteria: AC-01: project schema version 2 selects SQLite, GitHub Issues, or GitLab Issues by adapter id and target without provider runtime configuration or credentials.
AC-02: core retains provider-neutral TaskSource and TaskSink contracts and maps every canonical operation to provider tools or SDK methods.
AC-03: the dependency checker verifies mapped tool availability without constructing clients, authenticating plugins, or initializing providers.
AC-04: eng-project-governance reads the selected mapping, uses Session-provided tools directly, and never bootstraps the environment.
AC-05: documentation explains provider mappings, Session tool availability, system-of-record ownership, mirror ownership, and the version-1 migration.
AC-06: focused tests and Skill validation pass while the public registry remains exactly five Skills.
AC-07: the local candidate is pushed only to the named contributor branch and opened as a GitHub pull request.

goal-r1.summary: Move provider construction out of skill-creator while keeping a provider-neutral project binding, SDK contract, and dependency check.

architecture-r3.summary: Project configuration selects an adapter and target; the Skill maps canonical operations to tools already exposed by the selected provider plugin or to SQLite SDK methods.
decisions: Keep the TaskSource and TaskSink SDK contract in core.
Replace SQLite-specific project fields with adapter identity, binding, target reference, and contract version.
Delete the concrete SQLite runtime and provider lifecycle tests from core.
Maintain one provider-operation mapping for SQLite, GitHub Issues, and GitLab Issues.
Check only whether the mapped tools needed by the current operation are available in the Session.
Keep system-of-record and mirror-direction decisions in project governance while leaving mirror operation to the environment.
Use a breaking schema version without compatibility aliases or shims.

closure_decision.loop: project selects adapter and target -> mapping resolves canonical operation -> checker confirms Session tool -> Skill invokes provider tool -> result returns through the generic contract
closure_decision.success_signal: SQLite, GitHub, and GitLab selections validate through one schema and every adapter maps the complete canonical operation set
defer_until: provider conformance suites until runtime packages are added outside this core
reject: provider bootstrap in a governance Skill
credentials or client settings in project.yaml
a SQLite compatibility layer in core
closure_decision.replacement_seam: The operation mapping and TaskSource/TaskSink contracts are the provider seam.

gate_evidence.skill-structure-validation: repository-validator-pass; bundled quick validator unavailable because PyYAML is not installed

impact_record.reason: Replace environment-injected clients with direct provider-tool mappings after the user's architecture clarification.

remote_sync_decision.reason: The user explicitly requested a GitHub merge request after the redesign is complete.
